text:
First timers.... What an absolute treat this was for the family and I tonight!

Heard so many great things about this place and not to mention; we have been wanting to try this place for the longest time now... Note to self (and anyone else reading this)...Certainly not a bad thing but Saturday nights are extremely busy. We lucked out though and we were able to grab a table that had just been cleaned...score!

Pizza was amazing and holy cannoli their cannoli's were just as amazing! The pizza was a perfect thin crust cooked to perfection with just the right amount of sauce, cheese and other ingredients (I just wish they had beef as a topping option). From the time we placed our order till serving time was about 20 mins wait time...not too bad considering how busy it was. Roughly 10 tables that seat about 4 per table and a few of those tables seat only two. 

Will definitely be heading back to help support this locally owned business with a big heart and of course to satisfy my NY pizza cravings :)
Very friendly staff.  Great food.  They handled this whole COVID 19 crap very well and made our dining experience wonderful.

I've only been to the taco Tuesday one time. Street size and delicious ! I really liked the carne asada. Full salsa bar. And good margs, pre-made?? nice staff. Happy place. Cool decor. I would go back. Lots of items to try.

Trying to be healthy but also still eating out, so we tried here. We got the spicy tai shrimp wrap, sweet potato fries, and the breastocado wrap. They were all very good and fresh. It was perfect and just what i needed. I will definitely be back to try some more!
Love this place and the people. They were really professional with their service. Their prices were reasonable and food were good. Will come back again, when I have a chance to visit this city.

We have got deliveries from Crafty Soul a couple of times. We always get the short ribs. They are flavorful and falling off the bone tender. The Mac and cheese is extra cheesy goodness. My daughter loves the yams. I love the potato salad but she thinks it has too many onions. The greens taste like they may be vegan. Cooked with no meat added maybe. The first night it didn't taste as flavorful and savory as soul food greens usually do. The next evening, after the spices marinated a bit it was on point and delicious!! Portion sizes were huge!! Delivery was prompt. We would definitely continue to order from Crafty Soul.

What an unexpected find. This is an excellent Place to eat that specializes in Southern Indian food. We have gone twice: once for dinner and once for a Sunday buffet. Unlike the usual mess of every dish tasting the same, be prepared for a series of dishes that all taste home made. This is definitely on my regular rotation now for dine in or take out.
Two more weekend visits and the quality and choices  remain.

Love quills!! I have been going there for years!! I'm thankful that during this time, they are open and taking the necessary precautions to practice social distancing and making sure sanitary needs are being met. They also have online ordering during this time, which is contactless for those who want to just grab and go! I would definitely recommend their almond milk lattes!!!

My new favorite place to eat!   Food was wonderful.  I got the chicken with honey butter sauce, smoked Gouda Mac and cheese and sweet potato casserole.  The German chocolate cake is to die for.  Yummy!!  I can't say enough good things.  Will definitely dine there again on our next visit to Nashville.  Upscale comfort food!

This place has so many options for vegans, vegetarians and meat eaters. I have gotten the fish n chips, bbq chicken vegan philly and jackfruit philly. The service is amazing even during COVID-19 and I would definitely come back anytime I'm in New Orleans.

We were in town only a few days, but after our first trip to Oak and Stone, we had to return.
Now, I have to say, we ate at the bar both times, and that was a big part of our enjoyment. The staff is really, really friendly, and we had great conversations with several of them. I kept joking with them that I want to open an O & S franchise in New Orleans and want them to come run it.
BUT besides that,  the beer wall concept and selection is great, and the food is great. We had two different pizzas, and they were fantastic. The crust is perfect, and their house pizza options are creative and delicious. And the mac and cheese side was great too.
I'll say again: the interaction we had with the staff at the bar was a big part of the enjoyment, but the pizza really is great, and of course, there's the beer wall.
If only I really could open one in New Orleans.

This review is for take out only. 

We've ordered takeout from this restaurant a handful of times and each time the food has been delicious. The garlic Naan bread is cooked perfectly and has a great taste. Their food tastes so good and I recommend anyone to try this place. I also purchase the side of hot sauce as it adds great taste and flavor to the meal. 

Their delivery time is slower than other places so I would suggest ordering before the hunger strikes. The food is worth it though.
Nachos were the best I tried. Also the location is beautiful. My kids enjoyed sitting outside, enjoying the fountain of turtles.

I  used to come here all the time after work pretty decent alcohol prices the fish and chips were decent I didn't really care for the nachos but I would recommend you to come here they have a pool table and

Very cute atmosphere, albeit very small and extremely warm.   Delicious salad but very disappointed with short rib pappardelle.   Tomato sauce completely ruined the dish.  Pork chop was very moist and flavorful, but again disappointed with the sauce.   So many other restaurants to try, no need to come back again.
Today I met Jasmine she kind,  professional and a great example for all servers.  I pray that the corporate office will prommote her career and give her a fabulous bonus.

Really good home cooked food!! Get the stew!! It's slow cooked and made from scratch every day!! Sooo delicious and hearty!! Super cheap, blue collar ambiance, low key.  Don't let the industrial surroundings turn you off, this place has great food that is not fancy but cheap and delicious!! Not family friendly because they have a bar that is not separate from the rest of the restaurant.  If going for dinner check the hours they close somewhat early on some days.  Great spot for a no frills good home cooked lunch without the fuss!  Love John's, it's a local favorite and an Indy staple!!

This is a cute little restaurant with great service and knowledgeable staff. It's also BYO which is a nice plus! 

I found the menu to be quite limited, and there weren't many things that stood out on the menu that I wanted to try. I believe the menu is seasonal though so this may be different during another time of year. 

I ended up going with the gnocchi which did not have a sauce, and I was not a huge fan. It didn't have much to it and I was underwhelmed. My boyfriend ordered the short rib pappardelle, which he liked but the portion was quite small.
I've eaten here on three occasions and all I can say is that my cheese steak was excellent. My only complaint is why only a teaspoon worth of ketchup?

Great food but the service is lacking! The last two times I came here (drive thru) the person taking the order and payment seemed like he hated his job and didn't want to be working. Either get better customer service or don't be open.

FAST service! Nice ambience esp outside by the park. Good try with the babaganoush, but it needs to be fire-roasted & the focaccia served with is fine but offer wheat pita too.
The beers tend to the farmhouse ale side which is fine if you don't miss Fat Tire.

Great food and not too expensive! You won't break the bank for a good meal and amazing bar ! It looks so upscale, nice for a birthday dinner ! It's in the heart of the quarter so you can eat good and then go exploring. I am a hotel manager and it's my number one recommendation to my guests ! Go hear and I'm not paid to promote them ! Food is good

Another great evening at Guppy's. Great weather. Sat outside tonight on the deck. 
In the many times I gave been here, I have never had a bad meal. Never. Chef Scott has an ever changing menu and specials that make coming here a pleasure. 

This evening I had the lobster bisque with the evening special, Skirt Steak salad. My wife had the blue crab avocado appetizer and the Tuna Poke. 

All four items were prepared magnificently. The service was very attentive and not rushed. 

It's just nice to go out to dinner and just relax. Even during the height of tourist season.

Delicious is about all that matters!!!  A dear friend recommended we seek this place out  on our Philly venture.  So glad we did!!! 
Best philly I've had!! Cooked to order, your sammich, your choice.  The bread was a so soft / WOW! With a nice  crust!  
Not to mention toon the people filed oomph right after  us, do we definitely arrived at the perfect time!!  Greaat sErvice and nice folks works here too!

This is not Hawaiian BBQ at all. I have had Hawaiian BBQ in Hawaii and the quality of food is far from real thing. I drove 25 mins from this....in the trash and I spent $7.70 on this. The spam musubi is rice with a piece of spam and rolled in seaweed.  the mac salad is not homemade and tastes like walmart
They're closed for remodeling right now, but they are my go to take out restaurant in port Richmond.

The food is amazing, the staff and service is top notch! Nick Najem makes Flamme Burger a great spot to hang out and has made it very welcoming since Covid! There isnt anything on this menu I wouldn't recommend and the prices are great for the quality of food. Thanks Nick!

Wow! This place is delicious. This was some of the best seafood we have had in Indianapolis. If you are not from Indy and miss truly fresh seafood then this is your place! Other seafood restaurants in Indy either have seafood that you can tell has been frozen or the flavor/seasoning is just not there; but, at Noah Grant's this is not the case AT ALL. We ordered drinks, appetizers, entrees, and dessert... and I have ZERO complaints. Our waiter's name was Joseph and he was phenomenal. Based on our customer service and food selections I would rate this place a 10/10.
Quynh was a great server, service is always great as well as the food and drinks
Everything made from scratch. The food was delicious! We will definitely go back.  I love hot and spicy food and asked for my dish to be extra hot. It made my lips burn for hours. I loved it!!

Why can't we give 0 stars.
Don't come here. Read the reviews, they beg ones are true.
Customer service is absent. They simply don't give a damn.
After being ignored at the pick up window for over 10 min and yes they saw me I left.
Hubby has had bad experiences here but we kept giving it a chance. Not again. This family is done.

Absolutely amazing. Being Ramen Traditionalists, we have tried many ramen spots opening up in Tampa and more Asian restaurants adding it to their menu but we were always disappointed. 

We had the miso ramen with pork belly. The broth was amazing, not oily or too salty. The pork belly was delicious soft and meaty with the right amount of fat. The noodles were the right texture and tasty.

All I can say is WOW...this is a must try. It is a cup of coffee like no other you have ever experienced. I walked in thinking I was getting a cup of coffee... boy was I wrong. I had a cup of LOVE, JOY, HUGS, ART and an experience you have to try. The staff is very helpful and they don't rush you to place an order. The breakfast is amazing and the ingredients together make it magical. I was truly impressed by my morning cup of coffee. If you want to try something amazing and different this is the spot for you. I can only hope they come to the LA Area. Troy,  I am sorry I didn't not get to meet you in person but thank you very much for the hospitality.

This food is amazing. This is the most crave-able food I've ever had. The wait time is quick and there's always the to-go option. I highly recommend  anything with their fried rice and peanut sauce. The staff cares about their customers & food quality. Pro tip - you can order extra sauces!

Never tired of canal bistro. 

I'm surprised I've never rated this restaurant before considering i eat here at least once a month. True story: i once ate here 4 days consecutively and I'd do it all over again

Okay, so to really start my review I'd like to first give credit where credit is do. Something that makes canal bistro truly stand out (besides their amazing garlic feta fries and gyros) is the customer service. I've personally seen the owner walk around and make sure all customers are well taken care of. The servers and hostess are ALWAYS in a good mood and extremely friendly. I've never had a bad customer service experience here, in fact, they go above and beyond with their service.

Second, I'd like to give the MVP award to their garlic and feta cheese fries. Whoever came up with that combo deserves the Nobel Peace prize because it truly brings people together. 

Third, id like to give credit to my favorite two things on the menu: Gyro (ofcourse) and the Greek salad with salmon. The gyro is juicy, crunchy, and soooo delicious. I daydream about the gyros at canal bistro. The Greek salad with salmon is fresh, tasty and filling. It's so good! 

Before i end my review, id like to give credit to the martinis. So good, the bar tender really knows what he's doing. 

If you're thinking about making an appearance at canal bistro, please do so! Sit outside, enjoy the breeze, drink a martini and order the gyros with feta garlic fries. You'll thank me!

(Pita bread and Olive oil

First time for us. Beautiful decor inside and out. We ate in the tavern. Very intimate and the bartender was very friendly and a superb mixologist. The waiter was also very friendly and attentive. All our food was excellent. The prime rib was world class. We will definitely be back.

Very disappointed, I got it delivered tonight for the first time ordering from there and my pizza was over cooked and cold . After couple bites I threw it all out. I feel fooled by other reviews , it was a plain pizza and cost 13 bucks. Also got fries and they tasted soggy.
Awesome food. Wait staff was helpful. Live music, games, great atmosphere for dining or grabbing a drink with friends after work. Great idea and wish there was a place like this where I live!

First of all, I've never been to bearcat bc I was told they don't have a liquor license. BC what's brunch with no bloody Mary's? Let it be known that the Bearcat on CBD does serve alcohol. They're food was amazing. We had the cat daddy, buffalo cauliflower, Xiong mao noodles.   Surprisingly, the Xiong mao noodles were the best. I' ll definitely be returning

The employees are so rude!!! We tried two different times to come and never felt welcomed. We just wanted coffee to go the second time and the hostess yelled at us. We went to 417 union instead and we had the Best service!! Would not recommend going here. Go elsewhere!

I'm spoiled by growing up in NY that being said the veal parmigiana is excellent. Crab stuffed mushrooms a must , they'll make anything to order . Wait staff is excellent, priced moderately I'll be back - get the cookies they're a little expensive but worth it
The owner of this sandwich shop drove out of his way to bring us cookies that the third party delivery service did not grab when retrieving our food. Best customer service I've seen in quite a while.

The salt and pepper squid was sublime. The eggrolls are handmade per your order ( in lieu of pre-made frozen and warmed over). For dinner entree, I highly recommend the garlic shrimp.  Beginning mid-Sep 2019, they intend to have a liquor license--there will be no need to byob.

El Original Tacos Tijuana
2201 Prater Way, Sparks, NV 89431
March 11, 2020 Wednesday - 5:00 PM for dinner
2 Adults

Atmosphere -4 stars
Dinner - 4 stars
Service - 4 stars

Background - Dinner before some beers over at Piñon Bottle Sparks.  
 
Atmosphere - Strange fast food place.  The pair of front doors in the entrance become a wind tunnel on a windy day, which I noticed today.  Typical fast food you order with cashier but the kitchen is on the other side of the place.

Food 
  Dinner - If you read my reviews you know I love trying new things.  I ordered a Taco Azteca, just because it has cactus.  I determined it was just there for me.  No fault of the business.  I also ordered the Campechana Fries, yeah that was a mouthful for me.  They were excellent except one flaw, it is like carne asada fries taken to another level.  The only downside was the fries good have been cooked much longer, probably a minute for my taste.  All sauces made the fries too soft for my liking.

Service - Strange here also, you order and have to take your ticket to the cooks.  With computers today the receipt could print in the kitchen.  I know that is more money for the business but it flows so much better for everyone.  Signs everywhere saying they are not responsible for someone else getting your food.  What! Really?  The place was very slow so we were able to get our food without issue.

Future - Like to try some meat tacos as this visit was all about new stuff.

UPDATE 8-15-2020

RUN AWAY. RUN AWAY. RUN AWAY. 

We decided to give it another go... 

Big mistake.

This time they not only screwed up every item in the order, but this was a delivery order. When it arrived missing the $5 extra patty, I tried to call. No answer. Got in my car and drove all the way there, to find the restaurant empty. Went in to complain, and found myself getting yelled at by some douchebag named Dan. This idiot went full agro, puffing his chest, stretching his arms out, and screaming. 

It wasn't until I mentioned contacting the owner that he shut up. 

NEVER AGAIN! RUNN AWAY AS FAST AS YOU CAN!




Placed a pick up order over the phone and arrived right on time, actually saw my patties coming ooff the griddle... where they sat on a plate... for literally 20 min. That's how long it took for them to box them and take my money. 

Then a quick trip home, ready to dive into a burger. Needless to say, they were ice cubes, as were the fries. To top it off the patty and bun were burnt to a crisp. Well past the medium-well they state they target. 

Oh and they screwed up the toppings on on all 3 burgers!

I'd rather eat at Burger King!

The hot wings are to die for! (Better order two orders!) It was easy to order for delivery, and we got one of their many bundled "deals."  So, we got a 2 liter sodas, 10 hot wings, and a large 2 topping pizza, for under 30 bucks! They have a wide and unique selection of " culture driven"selections! Where else can you get an Indian pizza?  We are staying at the Sands, and so the owner met me in the lobby, after phoning me in advance, that he was seven minutes away, and we met him. During the Pandemic, it is especially important, more than ever, to tip your service providers!

Wanting to find some yummy, cheap seafood, we came across this restaurant in Tampa. No frills, no seats, and no real customer service. However, the food is above average. We ordered the medium crab plate. It came with a choice of two sides. The fried blue crab was oh so good, tasty and flavorful.  I chose corn on the cob and slaw as my sides. Not bad, nothing special. As a connoisseur of coleslaw, I found the salad a bit too creamy and lacking celery seed.  My sister ordered a side of garlic shrimp. These medium crustaceans had good flavor and not over cooked. The fish, fried grouper was amazing, (I tasted it.). While the hush puppies were over cooked, I came to the conclusion that this 'shack' focuses more on their main entrees than the accompanying sides. Their prices still make it a worthwhile investment and I recommend you try a meal.

Crazy to think I have live in Indy my entire life and this is my first time I have tried this place! It has a great bar vibe and plenty of drinks to go with it. I was so happy to see they had Rhinegeist Bubbles which is one of my favorites. I got the mac & cheese with truffle fries which were both simply amazing. And my friend got the grilled cheese which she loved as well. There is a good amount of outside seating which is nice for warmer weather and there is both a family and a bar side on the inside. The service was pretty good, too, and social distancing procedures were in place as well. All around a great experience and I can't wait to go back!

My go too for spirits.  Large selection. Love the frequent wine tastings.  The take out is divine.  Love the uptown location.  My recommendation, go to the wine/spirits tastings.  They are a joy! And you meet people without any pretense.  They have different themes.  I enjoy each of them.  I enjoy their sales on wine/spirits.  Cannot be beat!  Tip: go out to their website to view upcoming tastings.  Also, sign up on their mailing list for their sales.

Was driving by and noticed this place for the first time. I believe the advertisement sign read "Indiana's oldest drive-in." Yes, drive-in not drive-thru. Basically you drive up, park, and a waiter will walk out to you to take your order. Note: credit card payments are accepted but tops must be done with cash. We tried the tenderloin. It's a pretty no-frills Indiana tenderloin. Seemed like a popular place with many cars stopping in to order. 

Worth the stop if you're in the area.

The employee with the blue hair who took my order and payment was totally lacking in customer service. Asked for a receipt and she just pointed to the next window. I pull up to the next window, no receipt and they got my drink wrong. What's happening to customer service. If the owner reads this post, fix this soon or you're going to lose business.

Just wasted $55 on carry out. I've eaten inside a few times and it's always been solid. They burnt my sons Kobe sliders and over toasted the buns also. 3 patties of charcoal. I spent $15 on a prime rib sandwich that had about 1oz of meat. Should rename it Double bread which, since that's all I tasted. My Cole slaw was def left over from yesterday. Brown and dry, never even bothered eating it. Straight to the trash. Our cheese and bacon fries were burnt, way over cooked. Hard as a rock. The only positive was the French onion soup. Very tasty with plenty of cheese and meat. Again I've previously had good food here, but the cook musta been having a bad day cause most of my order was over cooked, undersized and over priced.  1 and done on the carry out here!!
Best country fried steak, biscuits, gravy and home fries in Reno.  Worth the wait to get in.

I was very pleased to find a fine, yet modest environment for a wine shop/restaurant when I moved to Indy. They have an amazing selection of wines, including natural (!!!), and the best part is the price to take a bottle home is the same to drink in house. You can't beat that!

The staff is always friendly and accommodating. The food is delicious and they can help you perfectly pair a glass of wine with whatever dish you're eating. They also offer brunch and to-go wine slushies, what's not to love?!

Great environment for catching up with friends, a boozy brunch, or a romantic date night! Highly recommend popping in, whether it be for a glass of wine or multiple bottles!

This restaurant keeps being brought up and I had to give it a try! I got the chicken pad Thai and it was very good and I would definitely get it again! Small restaurant but seems to do very good with takeout and have several options!

So, it was national bagel day recently, and I hopped on Yelp to see where I could get a bagel close by, that's when Brueggers popped up! First of all, how did I know it was so close to my office! The line was long, but they were very quick and I didn't have to wait long at all.  I went with the Farmhouse, double egg. It was DELICIOUS. So delicious, that I've been back about three times since! It's loaded with ham and cheese and egg and it's on a cheese bagel!

 I send all of my friends and colleagues here and I HIGHLY recommend anything on their menu! Everything is wonderful, but my go to is still the Farmhouse!

We ate at this restaurant a couple years ago and swore we'd never go back. The chicken was crunchy and wings wouldn't come off the bone. But when we heard it was under new ownership we decided to give it another try. Very glad we did. The wings were clean, juicy, and the rub was awesome. The chicken was great as well, you could really taste the bbq brine. Wings, fries and green beans all delicious. I'd highly recommend ArdmoreQ to any bbq lover.

I wish I could post a picture of my garlic knots but I ate them all too quickly! I also love how they have no straw lids because it's great for the environment! It's always clean and they staff is very kind too!

I came here after hearing so many good things about their gumbo. I ended up just getting side orders of their seafood gumbo and jambalaya to try. 

The gumbo was delicious, and had huge pieces of seafood in it. One of my complaints is that a quarter of my little side of gumbo was taking up by a giant oyster which hadn't been cut up at all. It was pretty tricky to eat!

The jambalaya was just okay, nothing special.

The ambiance is definitely interesting as well, with it being cafeteria style and incredibly hectic. Our waiter was friendly thought, and service was prompt. I definitely don't think this place is worth all the hype!

First off....the food was amazing.  The staff was amazing.  We had an appetizer and a round of drinks while we waited for our to go food.  Unfortunately one of our meals was incorrect.  I think the customer in front of us grabbed ours by accident.  We realized it when we got home.  Called the restaurant and with no problem they immediately credited us with the price of the meal.  Apologized and hoped we enjoyed the order we did receive....which was great!!!!  
That's the way to get return customers....great food and perfect service.

I gave this place a try twice thinking maybe it's what I ordered. I tried the Drunken Noodles and Pad Thai and they both taste very bland. I ended up having to flavor it myself at home.. I was shocked the Pad Thai wasn't good because it's a very standard dish.

What can I say? It was a lovely experience! We made reservations online via OpenTable, where my fiancé mentioned that it was my birthday. Upon arriving the host wished me a happy birthday, and seated us at a table that had confetti sprinkled on it.

We both started with cocktails, and they were beautiful in presentation, and tasted delicious, too! We were also served warm ciabatta bread to eat along with our starters.

We ordered the Polpette di Vitello (meatball) and a special of the evening, the mozzarella burrata. The meatball was delicious, but the mozzarella was a show-stopper. It was easily the best mozzarella I'd ever had, and I've been to Italy.

We ordered the lasagna and the penne alla arrabiata, and they were both outstanding. We enjoyed a recommended bottle of red wine to go with it.

Since it was my birthday, we indulged in dessert, and it was brought out to me with a little lit candle. 

You really can't go wrong here. We will definitely be returning to the Italian Barrel!

My dad and I took a trip to New Hope and came across this cute little Italian place. My dad ordered "the voice" and I ordered "the bomb". Both sandwiches were great! The guy running the place was friendly and had made suggestions to what we ended up getting. The decor was all Frank Sinatra which I happen to be a fan. There was two parts to this place, one side where the tables were and the other side is set up like a little Italian market. Me and my dad sat outside where they had Frank Sinatra playing on an outside speaker as we ate. Very nice vibe all around with great customer service and food!
Food was good, outdoor seating is nicely distanced. Salad, tacos and potsticker were good, cheap beers. Can't wait to go back!

Each time I'm in Boise this is a MUST have! Fresh and yummy with vegan options- The bonus is sitting outside at the bistro tables. 
It won't matter what you order it's ALL AMAZING.
Love that's kind of hidden great view with great drinks. There was people staying at the hotel and had no idea the great bar upstairs they had.
Excellent food and service. I could eat there every day, but I wouldn't know what to do with all the leftovers (huge portions)..

Now think about this. I am a pure carnivore. I like my meat with a side of meat. This place from what I had isn't bad. In fact it was downright delicious. We ordered the nachos and these were loaded with everything you'd want on nachos (except meat). The only complaint I had was that these were very salty (probably making up for the lack of meat flavor). For a vegetarian place that I would never order from on my own and will only order from when forced to do so, it was pretty good. They would have gotten 5 stars but there was so much salt on the nachos I still haven't peed and I ordered this over a month ago!!!

Bartaco is an energetic full filled place and you will be contagious by the celebration vibe just crossing the door. 

I went there without reservation so the lovely hostess announced memo should wait about an hour to get a table, but I could try to look for an available spot at the bar and just have a seat, as I did.
 
It was an early hour on a Sunday night, and the vibe felt like a Saturday night. Everyone was so nice, and friendly, cheering drinks and enjoying tacos and shared dishes like anyone had nothing else to do the next day.

I sit alone at the bar corner and had a great conversation with a lovely couple who shared some tasty plantains with me.

I get a Tecate, and 4 different tacos: Baja fish, mojo pork carnitas, portobello and crispy rock shrimp. I liked all of them, even the Baja fish and the shrimp were fried weren't grassy at all. Everything was perfectly cooked and delicious, and I finished my meal feeling great without being over filled. (Even more knowing in advance the calories of any dish! Haha)

Oh and I tried 2 sides as well: the spicy cucumber and the Asian slaw! 

I had a great time in that place, the perfect spot if you wanna hang out with your friends, having a few drinks enjoying a delicious food as well. The perfect spot to put you in your way for having a great night!

Pupuseria Casa Maria... what can I say about this small hidden gem located in this strip mall on North Michigan besides EXCELENTE!! First off, this place is still open during the COVID-19 quarantine just be sure to place an order through the Yelp app or call in ahead of time for pick up! Second off, my friend showed me this place before he left for Seattle. I'm from Venezuela and sometimes I'd make us some arepas from time to time. He told me about this place and I was hesitant just because I was unsure what a pupusa was. But man was I glad I made the decision to go! The pupusa remind me of arepas since I believe they are made the same way and I feel I can never get enough of them. Every time I go to Casa Maria's, the Chorizo & and Cheese, as well as the Chicken & and Cheese AND the Revuelta are some of my favorite pupusas to order. Also if your feeling super spicy, I'd go with the red orange sauce instead of the green one.

If you're trying to get something different instead of Mexican for the second night in the row, I recommend coming out to this fabulous Salvadoran kitchen.

This is a magical culinary spot in our city.  I must give huge kudos to the amazing beautiful decor inside and outside with a wonderful attention to the details. 

We got seated outside on a beautiful Cinco de mayo day; service and food were amazing. 

We started with margaritas and guacamole.  They have pecans in them a real treat. 

The queso has okra in it , really delicious. Then tacos then corn on the cob, so damn good. 

And finished with sopapillas and tres leches bread pudding. 

All delicious and full of flavor. Love the place. 

Enjoy.

The secret is to have an insider...who has been there before...

We went there for a dinner for three.  One of the party had been there before and having a 'guide' made a world of difference! We ordered  series of dumpling apps and some salads - excellent.  

Entrees were the beef and noodles, chicken and vegetables.  Simple dishes with explosions of flavor.

The wine list is simple and the place is not meant to be for wine - the food lends itself to beer but they do have some nice bourbons

I recommend this place

Little convenience store, they call it the "Blue Store" and sells hot plates and boiled seafood. I like their crawfish, it has a nice little flavor to them. To me it was a little on the expensive side like $5 and some change for 1lb of crawfish. 

I believe they take debit card as well. But I like to be safe and some places it's safe to just pay with cash.

If I could do less than 1/2 star I would !!!!!!  No doubt all these 5 star reviews are BULLCRAP.     I ordered wedding cake 5 weeks in advance told no prob.  I have heard from many people including wedding venues that Swiss is EXTREMELY INCONSTANT. That I must beware hit or miss is there speciality.  Well I got a total MISS.    $100's of dollars later the presentation was horrible looked like a 1st grader iced it.   And the absolute DRIEST CAKE I HAVE EVER EATEN.  OUR GUEST WERE LEAVING THE CAKE ON TABLES AFTER ONE BITE.   It was embarrassing.   I got on the mic and apologized to my guest and announced to all of our guest now you know where NOT To order your next event cake.    It was soo nasty and ugly.  I will post the pics of this mess as soon as I get them.   I called and Sarah is the manger an the girl who answered the phone was the same idiot who helped me and pushed to know what call ref too and of coarse Sarah was to busy to come to phone and I do not expect a call back because as I have heard they don't care nor do they do anything ever to make good on the crap they deliver.  So please all be warned be very warned.  2 experiences so far -  1 was just ok nothing to brag about and this wedding cake was an absolute MESS.  NOT TO MENTION AS THE IDIOT WAS HANGING UP WITH ME SHE LAUGHED AS IF TO SAY SO WHAT !!!!   I will blog everyday till Sarah the supposed manager calls me back with an explanation or fix of some sort for the crap delivered to my daughters wedding !!!!!!!

The vibe of CR Hero's is like your local bar and sports restaurant. Numerous TVs play a variety of things from sports to cartoons. There is a bar area that is in a room separate from the main dining area. 

There are a variety of food options so be sure to explore the menu. I got the fried pickles and crispy chicken wrap with onion rings. Both were tasty and plenty to eat! 

The service was good and there are more items I look forward to trying so I plan to come back!

- fast delivery
- very delectable amazing sauce
- the shrimp dont come with shells which is a huge advantage
- It was so good, I ordered again, two hours later

I always want the option to eat at Thai Taste!  I hope it stays open a long time. Every. Single. Dish is delicious and fresh and fills me with happiness. Some of my favorites; Spring Rolls, Mieng Kum, Papaya Salad, Pud Kra Prow!  Yum yum yum!!!

I've been here several times and every time is amazing. The atmosphere and staff are great and the food is even better. I get the miso ramen and it's very savory and rich and the noodles are perfect. The perfect amount of noodles to brother and toppings. Always leave satisfied.

Brand new restaurant, we couldn't wait to try. The place looks great, the atmosphere is really awesome. Very nice staff, great service. Our cocktails were fantastic. My only drawback was that when I got my seafood meatballs over pasta, I was a little surprised to see that the meatballs were sitting on completely naked, dry, unseasoned pasta. With that said, the meatballs were delish, and we will be back.

We love red lion!!! They have been so clean and concise during COVID. their staff is also very friendly. 

We love the fish and chips, Buffalo wings, onion rings,  scotch eggs, Buffalo chicken sandwich. 

The food and atmosphere is great. Must try! Classic place in fountain square :)
We love their wings, in particular the Mango Habanero!  Their pizza is good and their cheesy bread comes in big portions!!

Had a short layover in the area and was looking for a quick fish sandwich. The Hogfish was excellent with great flavor. I'm in the area every year during spring and this location will be our new must stop while on the beach

I came in for the first time ever in search of a great vietnamese sandwich. AND I FOUND IT. the bread and veggies were so fresh and i couldn't believe how amazing the price was. super customer service as well!

JUST AMAZING!! 

Pretty outside and inside, great servers and staff. 
Just what we needed in Brownsburg!!

Great and easy location, I recently ordered some Fried rice, Orange chicken, some fried veggies/shrimp (really yummy!) PLUS a amazing Thai beer  I swear you won't disappointed, you need to try it, it's pretty good and it's not too strong.

My girlfriend and I have been living in Nashville for quite some time now. We heard great things about Merchant so decided to bring our families here together for the first time. The staff was so rude to us the moment we entered the restaurant. I'm so embarrassed to say we brought them here for their first time in Nashville. We will never be back.

OMG If I could eat the lobster cargot every day I WOULD! I got it as an appetizer the first time I went and raved about it all night to my husband. I went back like 3 days later to get it again. Between two visits i/we have tried the salmon (good), shrimp and scallops (really good!) and the meatloaf (great!). I can't wait to eat here again. The drink was a French 75. Really tasty and I don't even like Gin! Can't wait to go back!

Went there on a week night. It's a small place and remember BYOB. There is a bottle shop that is open late nearby but it's better for beer than wine, so remember to buy wine well ahead of time.

Small place limited menu but every item, we tried 6 amounts the 3 of us, was excellent. The desert was fantastic so I gotta day it was a great find in an otherwise slow town.

This is our favorite Salvadoran restaurant. We love their pupusas (chicharrón as well as frijoles). We also buy their pastelitos (meat filled fried dough). Staff is super friendly and I feel at home. We could eat here every day. Price is reasonable and affordable.

Everything about this restaurant is incredible. The ambiance, the cocktails, the dinner, the service. I couldn't get here fast enough to leave a review. My partner and I came for date night. My parnter is a chef and he was as impressed as I was. We got the Bistro Steak and Seared Salmonn with the Fritto Misto as an appetizer.

Spicy food doesn't mean that you need to add black or white pepper that burns your tongue. Being an Indian restauranteur myself and owning 10 restaurants, I can safely say this is some of the worst Indian food I've had. Please try to improve your food quality.

Dope hidden gem. Not all the bartenders are super friendly but the drinks are pretty awesome as well as Dean's Angel Wings!!  We frequent the spot often because the wings are just that great. Customer service is a lil shaky but still worth the visit!!

I had really high hopes for Umai Umai.  But after going for the first time, I was slightly underwhelmed. It was good and creative sushi, but it wasn't amazing and it was not the best sushi I've had in Philly.  They take reservations but the restaurant itself is very small. It was also really hot the day I went, and they didn't turn on the air conditioning, which may have affected my experience. 

For two people, we ordered the tapas for two, the chirashi, and two rolls--the henrietta and godzilla rolls. The service was pretty slow.  It took a while to order because our waitress had a lot of other tables to serve and she eventually came over to us to get our orders about 30 minutes after we sat down.  The actual food itself also took a really long time to come out, given that it's sushi...we ended up having a 2.5 hour dinner when really, it could have been about 1.5 hours. 

I enjoyed all the food, and the chirashi was really pretty/good, but we left feeling hungry still. They were not the biggest portion sizes, and I probably would have just ordered rolls and not the chirashi/apps if I had known ahead of time it was not going to be as filling. I liked the concept of the sushi there, but it was just not overwhelmingly good.

Now, I, personally am not a big fan of Bob Evans. My mother on the other hand absolutely adores the place. So a little while back i decided to take her out to breakfast.

Service was fine, the Woodhaven location doesn't get all that much traffic, so seating was fast, service was about average. Pricing is a bit much for what you get. I opted for a simple steak and eggs, steak was pretty good. Eggs a bit rubbery for my taste, due to my diet i didn't get to try the home-fries, but they looked pretty decent- and from my past experiences with the brand, they probably were, ditto for their biscuits.

If you are doing breakfast i would absolutely recommend the sirloin, it has a surprising amount of flavor especially when compared with their sausage.



Flavor & Presentation 2.66/5   |   Speed & Service 3/5   |   Pricing & Portions  2/5

Overall  2.5 / 5

Egg was awesome! My husband and I work completely different schedules and rarely get a day off together, and unfortunately weekdays are usually when they happen... in the interest of supporting local, we hopped online and searched Tuesday Brunch and this is where we landed...

We walked in, at like 1230 and the bartender (who I assume is..) the owner, handed us 2 menus, and asked us to sit wherever. They have a space that would otherwise fit a large number of people if there isn't a global pandemic happening... but the whole place is clean and well organized, and socially distanced! 

There's a pretty great "brunch" drink menu available, and it seems that their coffee/tea/beverage menu was pretty legit as well. We had the espresso martini, that complemented both our dishes flawlessly! 

The food menu is very southwest/Mexican, and has a variety of tastes available... I had cornbread Benedict with pork belly, and the hubs had baby back ribs with beans and green chilies, and eggs in a delicious looking sauce! Pics (of drinks and MY food below ). The ribs were tender as could be, and I've never had a better cut of pork belly prepared better! We left in a serious food coma, and will be happy to return again very soon!

Giving this place a rounded 4 stars for the food. I ordered delivery over the weekend, since it was my first time I went with my go to Indian meal which is fish tikka masala, keema naan and a mango lassi. They were out of fish, so I switched to chicken, no biggie. I also asked for extra gravy because I love to dip my naan; this was a mistake. They did give me extra gravy but there were so few chicken pieces in the half pint delivery container. It's like they swapped gravy for meat. Now I know! The food was very well prepared and seasoned. I would've liked more spice but I will mention that next time I order. The keema naan was absolutely delicious, especially dipped in the tikka nasals gravy. I enjoyed the mango lassi but likely wouldn't order it again. It had an odd coloring to it and that put me off. Overall, I'd order from this place again but I'd call the order in and pickup to make sure my customizations are understood. Always happy to find a new Indian spot!

Oh so yummy...and generous with their portions.  Found this place on Yelp when looking for a good breakfast place. It didn't disappoint.  The biscuits and gravy were delicious...with plenty of crumbled sausage all the way through. Servers are very friendly. Sometimes service is a tad slow, depending on how busy they are. However, if you're a breakfast lover and in the area...go!  You won't be disappointed. (We ate here three times in one week when vacationing in the area.)

If you're thinking about ordering out from little nonna's instead of dining in- DO IT. DO IT. YOULL THANK YOURSELF LATER. 

After dining in before the latest covid restrictions, I couldn't wait to go back. I was craving the garlic bread sooo badly, so I decided to order it and give takeout a try. I always get so nervous with take out especially delivery because the food can sometimes get soggy or mushy. But you guys, I was so impressed. 

The pastas came so yummy and everything was warm. Even the toast was crispy. Highly recommended the burrata and the garlic bread, don't sleep on it.

Great spot, great price, and tasty authentic Indian food. Ordered the Lamb Korma and Palak Paneer; they were delicious. The Garlic Naan was good, but could have been a little crispier. Would definitely be ordering from this place in the future.

Amazing as always! We finally got to take my in-laws after years of telling them about the "world famous" wings! Finally my FIL got to try them and agreed! We love that this location is family friendly so we can visit more often with our two year old as well! 

Pretzel crusted fried pickles are a MUST and hermanaki boneless are the way to go (with a side of fries). Seriously, If you haven't tried this place out, what are you waiting for???
Food was okay, my major problem with it was the 95 degrees out and all the garage doors up. Way to hot for me. The people who worked there were nice. I don't know how they handle that heat all day.

Favorite Mediterranean spot in Philly. We've been coming here for years . The owner is attentive and goes out of his way to be accommodating to us . The food is always good , fresh and plentiful. We will be back soon !!

What is with you guys and the feta cheese?  I order a white pizza with feta, and there is so little feta that you almost can't even taste it, much less see it.  Time after time.

So I ordered double feta.. Ok, that was a little more like it.  So tried that again the other day, and back to the "barely can taste the feta" pizza.  I got charged for double feta, though.

Too bad because the pizza tastes pretty good otherwise, good crust and such, but am tired of getting chintzed on the toppings. 

EDIT: In response to the note below..  I decline to provide my phone # because I feel that the appropriate toppings should be on a pizza because it's good business, and it's the right way to make a pizza.  Not just because it's me placing the order.  Today, I tried the double-feta pizza again as a "secret shopper", and sure enough, I got charged for two toppings but there was virtually no feta on the pizza.  Either the employees don't listen, or nothing was said by management.  Either way, I gave them a chance to redeem themselves and they failed, so I'm done with this place.  On to the next.
Wonderful neighborhood spot. Wait staff and owner friendly and accommodating. Food was fresh and tasty. Also, don't forgot to leave without ordering a cannoli.

On my way over there this morning after I had a great lunch there yesterday onion rings and make me want to go back for doubles Desmond & rest of the customer service hospitality satisfying and helpful

My husband and I had dinner reservations at another nearby place, but stopped in for a couple appetizers and beverages. This was my first time here and the atmosphere is cozy, quaint, and covid safe. We didn't want to take a real table, so we sat at a high top in the back bar area. I could see they had ample outdoor seating as well. 

I ordered the octopus and O.M.G. it was the best octopus I ever had. It was tender, light, and loved the orange segments, pickled onion, and drizzle. I ate this a couple of weeks ago and I'm still thinking about it. I order a glass of pinot grigio and it paired very well. The menu looks so good; I can't wait to go back and try more of the menu.

Service was excellent as well. They offer valet parking.
Great food last night. Steamed dumplings, won ton soup, chicken pad Thai and chicken with garlic and black pepper.  Everything was hot and fresh.  Lots of flavor.  Highly recommend!

Doormét really is a great spot to go if you're looking for a quick, delicious and inexpensive meal. The salad selections are great and the ingredients are fresh. I was surprised as how good their pizza was. To be honest, although they're specifically known for it, I'd say their pizza is in my top spots in Tampa bay. The crust is light with a light crisp and chew to it. The toppings are fresh and it's not too heavy. It was clear they do a lot of carry out and delivery orders but even as dine in, I highly recommend giving them a try!

Very poor management. Told us to leave while in line before closing. Literally standing in line and told we won't serve you, we close thirty minutes prior to the actual time that we post that we do. Then I was told I can walk across town to another location if I felt like it. Won't be coming back. Suggest you don't too. Manager was Stephanie. Horrible commination and customer service. I would imagine businesses would be loving eager customers during the shortages.

We have loved the Cheesecake Factory long before it arrived to Reno. We used to go there back in San Francisco for dessert after a night out in the town. Our favorite cheesecake is the Red Velvet White Chocolate Cheesecake. I must admit that I was able to hack the recipe and now I make my own version, but when I really want a treat we sneak here for a good piece of cake. 

Lately we started coming here for our sinful Sunday brunch. The brunch menu is limited; however, you still get the amazing bread, you can indulge on dished from the large menu and those in the group that are really into brunch can get their fix of waffles and pancakes. And of course we can always enjoy another piece of our favorite cheesecake.

What a great spot. Food is amazing and huge portions.  Staff is super friendly.  If you like fried mushrooms you won't find any better than here.   The grouper is gigantic.  You couldn't ask for more.

Cute and cozy atmosphere. Went in for a quick breakfast with my hubby. We were seated right away. The waitress was very bubbly and helpful. She suggested a few things and I ordered the Chile chorizo omelette upon her suggestion. My hubby ordered a side order of biscuits and gravy. He said the biscuits were dense and the gravy was good, but wished there was a little more gravy to finish the biscuits with. The omelette was delicious, but I would have liked it to be spicy. The omelette also came with a side salad with a lemon vinaigrette and multigrain toast. The waitress brought me a couple samples of their juices; both of which were yummy. I ended up taking a cup of the iced spiced chaider to go.
They were very kind here and put together take out with care. The pho was hot and flavorful and the hot Vietnamese coffee delicious!
I ordered a salad through the app for pick up and everything was fine until I got home. I was very disappointed to find that they put the wrong dressing on it!!

Chef Ma first came out in his civies to greet us. I asked him to please stand for a photo with us and he graciously went back to change into his award winning "Iron Chef" competition uniform for this photo with my kids!

Don't let the exterior former Taco Bell motif fool you! Chef Ma's cuisine that we enjoyed yesterday is easily very competitive with any of the very best Chinese restaurants in San Francisco, Los Angeles and Vancouver Canada Chinatowns! 

And his "Chewy Rice with Chinese Sausage" was better than the best I've had in GuangZhou, China! Cheers!

Visited for friend's birthday. Due to COVID 19 restaurant was 25% with reservations required. The reservation was quite easy to make on the website earlier in the day. We arrived about 10 minutes early and were seated within a couple minutes. We were early around 4 o'clock and discovered there's no happy hour on Saturday which was OK. We enjoyed the appetizer sampler. There was a ton of food and it was very good. 4 crab wontons, 4 dumplings, 2 spring rolls and some edamame. Two different sauces were also provided. For dinner we tried the honey shrimp and were provided white rice and brown rice because my friend mentioned she liked both. We had a glass of house cab which was a Casey I believe. The server was attentive even though she had several tables due to the reduced capacity. I actually only saw two servers in the restaurant. But we never felt neglected or ignored. She had a very enjoyable birthday and we will of course go again soon.

My husband and I were engaged at Chellos so this building holds a space in our hearts and I was very excited to bring our children to this new restaurant in the same location.
They had a really nice high chair for our toddler and a good variety of items on the kids menu. Both of my children enjoyed the pancake muffins with scrambled eggs and fruit. This is definitely a quiet small town restaurant, so I was nervous to bring my rambunctious children but everyone working was so very friendly and understanding. 
The adult menu isn't your standard dinner menu. They really turn up the flavors and add that artsy feel to the food that resembles Safety Harbors art culture. I had the bourbon Florentine Benedict with the magical potatoes and was very impressed with all the flavors! I was also able to have a taste of the yummy waffles!! Overall very impressed and can't wait to go back! 
Update: try the sweetheart mimosas & the Cuban breakfast sandwich! Breakfast and lunch all day!
BEST tacos I've ever had in Nashville and for the best price. Staff is so kind everytime & the margs are perfect!

Authentic, Elevated , Slow Cooked. 
This special spot was a nice surprise at what was thought to be a casual night out for Mexican flair in Reno. Well what I got was not your normal Mexican food. The flavors were plentiful and distinguished. The drinks, real none of the sweet sugar filler just good ingredients made to quench and deliver. 
I ordered a sweater weather and  Al pastor taco. Friends at the table shared amazing home made hot sauce and pumpkin tacos. Highly recommended will make a trip from truckee anytime! The chef and owner have created a space that offers amazing food, great mood, inviting warm outdoor space all with elevated authenticity. Thank you.

This place is below average and the service is terrible. Workers here don't know how to explain themselves.. had really hard time communicating. They ordered extra stuff on top of my tab that I did. Or order...
I've had a lot of really good Pho and this is right up there with them. Very good quality meat and the broth tastes great! Will definitely recommend to others.

Trust me the food is just as good as it looks. Very lengthy menu, and the waitress knew the menu very well. Food took about 20 minutes to come out which is pretty good if you ask me. Crispy and fried to perfection I would definitely recommend this place if you're looking for a hearty dinner!

We live around the corner and have been coming here on and off for twenty years. The food fluctuates in quality. Sometimes fantastic and artistic, other times meh. What is consistent is the extremely slow service. 

So sad, the Weezie cocktail is no longer available as the bartender left. Was always something to enjoy. I had potato skins which were crispy but filled with a cheese wizz that was reminiscent of a school cafeteria. We also had the million dollar shrimp app which is my reason for returning. Candied bacon wrapped shrimp 5 with a spicy mustard, delish. My daughter ordered the ribs which could be a disaster but we were delighted as the meat fell off the bone and was seasoned perfectly. Accompanied with steak fries and runny coleslaw.
Highly recommend having Freddie's tomatoes in season. Wonderfully fresh with either blue cheese or mozzarella , balsamic and red onion. Local farmer. 
Pineville is old and historic which is homey but the dead animals really need to be retired!!

Be very cautious when ordering vegan here. I was served meat when I clearly had indicated and even asked before opening my sandwich if it was vegan. Just make sure to check what you order if you have an allergy or if you're vegan.
So I was playing that new game pokemon go and I found a Krabby. That makes this visit worth while.

Hidden gem in the French Quarter! We went for the Friday brunch and OMG it was so delicious! We sat in the courtyard and received outstanding service from Marc- best service we've had in a long time! 
We started with the fried green tomatoes at his recommendation- 10/10 soo good 
We split the BBQ shrimp and grits, also at his recommendation and LOVED them! They rival Mr. B's (which is saying A LOT!) 
We finished with the beignets and they were amazing!

Have you sensed a pattern yet? We absolutely love this place and wish we would have discovered it sooner. We will be back again and again and again.

I received a gift card for Christmas for Kobes and I was beyond excited to finally try it, seeing as how we live less than a few minutes away and have been awaiting its opening.

Well, we were extremely disappointed once we finally got to go...

We went on a Friday, around 5:45. I REALLY did not expect a 45min-1 hour wait for two people, seeing as how they opened at 5pm, but we said OK. We were happy to see two open seats at the bar, and took those instead. What nobody told us was that you could not order full meals at the bar...we had no idea until we finally asked the bartender for menus and she explained they're still in there soft opening (hasn't this place been open for weeks...?) and therefore, food wasn't served at the bar. In addition to the bar space, there were a few booths in the bar area that were not allowed to have the regular menu as well.

So the only option was the hibachi tables, which explained the long wait..it seems silly that a couple has to join a party at a hibachi table to eat. Beyond that, we were only really able to get some sushi rolls which weren't anything to write home about. 

Giving 3 stars because our bartender was extremely nice, and running around the bar to serve everyone. She was apologetic when she found we were upset about not receiving the full menu. She was the best part of our experience!

Going forward, I'd rather visit Tsunami's and have the option to eat hibachi in the bar area rather than wait for two seats to open at a hibachi t
No bueno. Out of granola for açaí bowls, didn't offer substitute, slow service & overpriced. Açaí not great. Take your talents to sweet soul/blind tiger

What a nice find here in Riverview. In these trying times of COVID 19, I'm going to make it my mission to review the local businesses that have made me happy thus far. I have only eaten at Mi Casa once. It was the day we closed on our new home in Riverview. 3 days later all hell broke loose. My Brother ordered a quesadilla, my husband ordered a fajita and really I'm pretty unforgiving if you can't make a taco and you're a Mexican place, so to really gauge their handle on flavor and heat I always go wicked basic and get street tacos. Mi Casa had exceptional street tacos! My husband and brother enjoyed their choices too (so much I wasn't invited to share a bite). We all shared a yummy flan for desert. Our waiter/host was attentive, polite and even allowed us to sit outside when no one was out there yet. I can't wait for this "social distancing" to run its course I enjoyed the atmosphere and long to enjoy it again. 
Mi Casa may be doing take out right now but I'm housebound with asthma and while I'd love me a trip to Mi Casa, I'm staying home for my safety and the safety of others.

She made a beautiful and delicious cake for me for a baby shower! I sent her a photo of one i found online and she made it come to life even more beautifully than i expected! Each layer was a different flavor. Lemon with lemon curd filling was my favorite! Highly recommend!

Great Indian food!! Ordered to go twice in the last two weeks. Everything is well packaged. The Dosa, butter chicken, and biryani are delicious. This is our go to Indian restaurant in Wesley Chapel/New Tampa area. So happy to have authentic Indian cuisine near us. Will be ordering again this week!!

Really wanted to like this spot. It's hard finding a good Thai restaurant in the area. The first time we went there, the food was fantastic and we were excited to visit again. The next time the food was pretty bad ,but we thought it may have just been an off night since the first meal was so good. Fast forward 5 trips later. The food has been consistently bad.  Sadly, we've given up on thos place and wont be coming back

Great ingredients, unique flavors and the kids even enjoyed the honey ricotta toast! 
Worth checking out!

I tried this based on all the great reviews... I ordered fried rice and the cheese wontons. The wontons were stale, which is strange since they're deep fried. And the fried rice wasn't actually fried at all. It's yellow rice with what I assume steamed chicken... healthier, but also no flavor. I was disappointed for sure.

Kabuto has great ambiance, food and drinks. Unfortunately, the restaurant was unexpectedly under staffed, due to covid. I ordered a lychee martini which was absolutely delicious, and the hibachi scallops. The scallops were decent and the portions as expected for a hibachi grill. Prices are comparable to others in the area. I would definitely recommend coming here but do not arrive hangry! Overall, Kabuto is a 3.5 but will round up due to things that may have been out of their control.

beautiful county restaurant with a great atmosphere, we have dined here many times before and it's always fantastic.a varied house menu with nightly specials that never disappoint. the food is prepared, plated,and served beautifully. we highly recommend Arielle's for any occasion or just a night out.
Fabulous service. Great drinks. Wonderful atmosphere. Says it's business casual, but saw others there that were in casual wear. Great place for a date night.

We love this place! We have come here on date night, before events, and every time we need something delectable! 
We went again last night, we haven't been since this COVID mess, but we stumbled back to them and man it just doesn't disappoint! The melt in your mouth filet, double bone chops, and a cessation salad big enough for 4 people! All were perfect! But wait, there's more...the drinks...easy to get carried away here but they have something for everyone! I am attaching my drink...Lady from Hell! Amazing!! I highly recommend...go! You can sit outside or inside! The staff was great and food is absolutely fantastic!
Good ambiance and good local craft beer.  Waited a bit for a table and the bar was packed.  However a great menu and good service was worth the wait.  Scallops are amazing.

Amazing soup is created here. Small menu, but everything is great. The Tonkotsu Ramen (pork broth) and the Shoyu Ramen (chicken broth) are both delicious, smoky and savory. The pork belly and smoked chicken, mushrooms, egg and noodles are all cooked to perfection. The Gyoza dumplings and Gochujang wings are wonderful and filled with flavors. Smiling, helpful servers. Clean bathrooms. Wheelchair accessible. My family will visit again and again.

Have only had takeout but wow! So much better than Hampton Social (who also appears to not be social distancing , it's all in the name). Anyway, service was great and I appreciate the precautionary measures they have taken during Covid-19. The food was absolutely wonderful and inspired my husband to make his own version. We will definitely be ordering take out again and I hope to dine in very soon. Overall: 5 stars.

If you are looking for great Italian food I recommend Stassi's. This family run restaurant has been one of our favorite places. They have a huge menu and over the years the food has been fresh and consistently good.
Eat in or carry out. Give it a try I don't think you will be disappointed. Dianne, see you

Sept 5, 2020
Just picked up two shrimp scampi orders, salads, garlic knots, and deserts. WOW every thing was delicious as always! We have been dining at Stassi's for years and have never been disappointed. The food has always been good but the owners and staff make it a great experience. Very welcoming, friendly and just great people. My hat is off to Stassi's again!!!
Great place and great food. All food is authentic and they even have food you can come in and pick up if you are in a hurry.

Drinks were frigging amazing especially my French 75. Had to have two of them plus a cabaret Sauvignon. 
Food was really good. Hummus was creamy with crunchy chic peas on top. The pita is actually more crackers than pita. The pickled vegetables even though ok were too sweet to be considered pickles. Sliders were actually amazing  cheese and meat plate hit the spot with the Sauvignon. Little Gem salad was very fresh and delicious. Loved the buttermilk ranch dressing. Goat fries were good with the the vinaigrette dressing. OMG, the olives are sooo good. 
Our server was a young gentleman who was very attentive and offered great suggestions. We ordered everything he suggested. Appreciated the good food and service. Will definitely be back but will have to request Shyloh again and again.

I bought the Italian salad (absolutely fabulous) and beef lazagna (no stars) and heated it within the hour as directed on the package.  After 30 minutes in the oven, a lot of grease rose to the top of the dish. It didn't taste like it had any Italian herbs and spices and there was very little sauce on it and it tasted like Campbell's tomato soup that came from a mid-west middle school cafeteria.  The beef (greasy ground beef) didn't have any seasonings either.  Maybe it was just a bad day.  I would recommend the salad to a friend.

This place is a hidden gem! It's resembles a bodega. If your from NY and NJ you will feel at home. They store has everything you need. They also have bulk items you can buy and take back to the hotel: ice cream, cereal, popcorn, chips and cleaning supplies. 

The food they have is amazing! We ate here 3 days in a row. We had a burger, rueben, turkey Ruben, breakfast sandwich, chicken salad, and many deserts. The bread they make all the sandwiches on is the best I've ever had. 

They also have a wide array of wines and make sangria by the pitcher.

Went back after quite a few months 
Phone order for 2 hoagies order fries
Asked them to repeat and confirm 
They still screwed it up and where's the beef 
Disgusted

On the way to DC, picked this based on reviews and easy/on off.
Jumped on the waitlist ahead of arrival (I'd say it's a must on Sundays), waited 10 mins.
What a nice place. Nice vibe, friendly staff, and great food. We had chorizo omelet, chicken salad, and cobb salad
All excellent. If you like good food, made well, this is the place for you.

I like this fast food and beer concept. This open air concept is something new and interesting. The do have a garage type area for seating. At least this area has roof over it. This is a place to hang out for late night. 

The place has a lot different types of games on the ground. It is great to see that in the amenities of the restaurant. You can try different games and they are great. It is almost like cruise ship games area. 

The food selection is great. I would said Asian fusion yet can be Mexican or American cuisine. We got the chicken wings. This wing is almost like fried and bake. The coating is Malaysian Chili Paste. This paste is very similar to shrimp paste. Then top with fried garlic. Perfect touch. We also got grouper tostada. It interesting to have it. Not much memorable like the wing. 

Overall we like the concept with beer. A great hang out place. One thing to improve is tone down the speaker volume in the garage seating area. I understand they need to be loud for the people hear over the open area but not at the confine area.

We really were not hungry going into this place, but it was highly recommended by a friend and we wanted to give Adolfo's a try before heading back to California. There were four of us seated and empty tables surrounding us. We planned on ordering two entrees and three side dishes and were refused service due to not ordering four entrees. We were asked by our server, "oh did you not read this?" as she pulled out these "rules". Instead of ordering four entrees, we decided we would rather not give them our business.

I placed an order last night and went it to pick.it up around 7.  Only two guys were working and it was really busy.   I was in my way to the hospital bringing dinner and was slightly frantic and late.  When I arrived the guy behind the counter said they tried to call and my chicken would not be ready for another 45 minutes.   Well, I got a little upset.  I apologized and told him I was in the way to the hospital where a friend has been admitted and he went back to the kitchen, talked to the guy in the back and in 10 minutes I had chicken kabobs and the rest of my order and a chocolate cake.   Food was perfect and I felt like I was treated like a friend not just a customer.   Thank you Zoes Kitchen for understanding and taking care of me
